说明: 本记录覆盖阅读体验的一批源码改动和静态审查；不是 iOS 编译、模拟器运行、真机验收或全阶段完成记录。

changes.problem: 旧字体菜单只有名称，选择前看不到字形。
changes.implementation: 在同一设置导航栈内用一个原生 Picker 展示系统默认、现有两款内置字体和用户字体的字形样文；复用现有导入、删除和作用域存储。缺失字体禁用并说明；原书字体的实际字形以正文为准。

changes.problem: 开始阅读时需要逐项调整间距；新预设还必须避免覆盖延迟保存中的字号等编辑。
changes.implementation: 紧凑、均衡、宽松三个稀疏预设只定义行距、字距、段距。ReaderConfig 提交尚未回写的现有编辑并调用同一设置 writer，遵守逐字段全局／主题作用域；即使存储已匹配也同步编辑器并使旧延迟任务失效。手动微调后显示自定义。

changes.problem: 快捷面板只能拖动关闭，固定横排和背景卡在辅助大字下可能挤压内容。
changes.implementation: 提供原生关闭按钮；按实际导航占用调整面板高度；窄屏及辅助字号纵排，背景卡随字级缩放，移除翻页名称的强制文字缩小，字号上下限禁用对应按钮。保留既有亮度百分比、读屏信息和减少动态效果策略。

changes.problem: 按设备方向交换窗口宽高，无法可靠表示 iPad 分屏和台前调度中的阅读器边界。
changes.implementation: 一个可取消的 UIKit 边界观察器替代方向猜测和旧尺寸 preference；合并最新布局、使用最新闭包、忽略无效和重复尺寸、离窗或销毁取消。继续使用同一布局刷新和语义锚点路径。

fixedFindings: Preset application preserves pending ReaderConfig edits and supersedes stale pending spacing even when persisted values already match.
Scope tests initialize their paragraph-spacing baseline; publication tests restore sparse custom-theme data.
Viewport tests explicitly retain their windows across awaits and add a real SwiftUI background hosting scenario.
Large-text panel test waits for the actual final action frame and checks full viewport containment.

portableLocalizationScan.method: Lex all five Localizable.strings tables, compare key sets, require nonempty new values, check changed Swift literal localized calls.

cases: Three preset scope/preservation/custom-selection cases in ReadingSettingsScopeTests.
Three actual preset-entry publication/pending-edit cases in ReaderSettingsPublicationTests.
Six viewport component lifecycle, resize and cancellation cases.
One real UIHostingController background/container resize case.
One maximum accessibility text / Reduce Motion / reachable final-action panel case.

existingGuards: Only a current-ready chapter advances the window; each center requests the next two and previous two chapters with priority differences.
Same-chapter deduplication, jump priority upgrade, generation isolation and exit cancellation exist; downloads are kept independent.
Actual cached package reads validate modern body checksums and preserve corrupt legacy cache evidence.
unverifiedBoundaries: Lightweight cached-state detection can skip prewarming a corrupt modern body; entering the chapter performs full validation and on-demand recovery. A complete user-path reproduction is still needed.
Four requests per center is not a global in-flight bound across repeated distant jumps. Existing queueing policy must be measured before changing it.
Font import/delete still inherits synchronous file work from the existing service; this batch does not claim to improve its latency.

retain: median and maximum by fixture and stage
baselineCollection.acceptance: All output coverage/revision/readiness assertions must pass. First capture is descriptive; do not set a speedup verdict without a comparable prior measurement. Use five samples as median/max observations, not p95 or a device latency guarantee.

nextMeasurementScenarios: Use isolated synthetic 20/100-chapter fixtures with owned held responses and ten distant jumps; retain peak active/queued jobs, request order, cancellation and recovery.
Tamper only a temporary modern-cache body after a valid write, preserve package/meta, and verify both lightweight status and actual chapter-entry validation/recovery before selecting a fix.
Define startup and peak-memory collection separately; the single-chapter stage benchmark does not satisfy those acceptance gates.

configurationChecks: source selector counts reviewed as 60 methods and 62 executions
pendingIntegration.triggerPolicy: One stage checkpoint after related changes are reviewed; no tag is pushed during this implementation batch.
require: method and execution counts verified independently
manualSimulatorReview: font previews and selection, including missing/publication fonts
font import first-level presentation and deletion
largest Dynamic Type and VoiceOver order
theme/night contrast and native sheet close
font/spacing/mode changes and same text anchor

deferredDeviceValidation: Physical font comfort, actual night brightness/contrast and VoiceOver behavior.
Actual iPad multitasking/rotation, gestures and reading anchor stability.
Long-session responsiveness, memory pressure, thermal and battery behavior.
